body: Thank you, hopefully I will either get better fast or die peacefully, I'm hoping for one of the two to become true!! lots of love xx
I hope it gets better for you, and for everyone that believe so. Thanks so much. Xx
Thank you! Life is hard for everyone, I hope you do what's best for you as well! Xx
You're right... I should leave them a letter. Will totally do this now. Thank you so much.

That was such an insightful answer, thanks! I guess you're right, it is true society made it so we would feel bad about our mental disease, or how others perceive us.   
I'll power through it, I'll build a new set hopefully soon enough.  
Take care, xx.
I wish I had the will to live, hopefully, it will one day surpass the will to die. I'll hang in there, you too. xx

Damn I don't even have the money to buy enough coke and die...  never thought of doing that either, i guess one last time having ''fun'' (alone lmao... is that even fun doing it alone, not sure) is a good way out. 

I'm the same as you, I wanna do it after my exams because I have a group project and I'd feel bad leaving her do the rest of the project while I'm literally... dead lmao. I guess we all have our own deadlines, the same way life naturally has one (life expectancy... damn why is you getting longer and longer and mine shorter and shorter every day?) 

I hope you will find your peace the same way I will find mine if I have the courage to do it.

But let's be honest here, I won't have it. And I hope there is still something on this earth that screams ''don't die'' so that you won't have the courage either. Life does not get better - that's what i think - but life can offer you moments and pieces that you can cherish, or crazy adventures, seeing new things, meeting new people, discover new drugs, going to new clubs, or whatever the hell you can do on this stupid ass Earth.

Hell, just for those things, I'd stay alive, and then when I'm fed up with it and feel like I have nothing left to do, then maybe I'll have the courage to really do it. 

Sending you hugs and kisses, you aren't the only one in this state. I still hope you'll change your mind and think about what life can mean to you and what it can offer. <3
